name: Deafheaven
description:
'''Deafheaven''' is an American [[blackgaze]] band formed in 2010 in [[San Francisco]]. The group began as a two-piece with singer [[George Clarke (singer)|George Clarke]] and guitarist [[Kerry McCoy (musician)|Kerry McCoy]], who recorded and self-released [[Demo (Deafheaven album)|a demo album]]. Following its release, Deafheaven recruited three new members and began to tour. Before the end of 2010, the band signed to [[Deathwish Inc.]] and released their debut album, ''[[Roads to Judah]],'' in April 2011. They popularized a blend of [[black metal]], [[shoegaze]], and [[post-rock]], among other influences, later called blackgaze by reviewers.

Deafheaven's second album, ''[[Sunbather (album)|Sunbather]]'', was released in 2013 to critical acclaim, becoming one of the best reviewed albums of the year in the US. In 2015, the band followed up with ''[[New Bermuda (album)|New Bermuda]]'' and in 2018 with ''[[Ordinary Corrupt Human Love]]''. Their 2021 album, ''[[Infinite Granite]]'', reduced the black metal elements in favor of a shoegaze sound, with mostly clean vocals from Clarke. In 2025, they released ''[[Lonely People with Power]]'', a return to their blackgaze sound.
